items.name: page
items.title: Page
items.description: The page width, inset, and block spacing.
items.docs: Use the WorldBrain theme files and components.json aliases. Page needs the width-page and width-content tokens in worldbrain.css.

items.name: page-header
items.title: PageHeader
items.description: The page title, optional subtitle, and actions.
items.docs: Use the WorldBrain theme files and components.json aliases. PageHeader needs the leading-page-title token in worldbrain.css.

items.name: app-layout
items.title: AppLayout
items.description: The signed-in sidebar, account actions, and content frame.
items.docs: Use the WorldBrain theme files and components.json aliases. This block includes Page, so it needs no published WorldBrain registry URL.
